title: Luciana Nogales Montalvo, on three days at The AI Conference — 'And then came my favorite conversation of the conference'
summary: A sustainability and ESG specialist writes up her three days at The AI Conference in San Francisco — agents, infrastructure, cybersecurity, governance — and names the Ries–O'Reilly fireside as the session that stayed with her. She leaves carrying two of its questions: 'What would I rather die than betray?' and 'Survive, or stay true to our principles?'
blockquote:
And then came my favorite conversation of the conference: “Building AI Companies That Matter,” with Eric Ries  and Tim O'Reilly .

It shifted the conversation from what can we build with AI? to something much bigger:

What kind of companies do we want to build?
